chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: What is the normal trial period?

options.text: 2 years
1 year
3 years

comment: Normally, the probationary period is 2 years. But there are also situations where it can be extended to up to 4 years.

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: You are currently in the probationary period and to date have not come to the attention of the authorities. What consequences may result if you fail to observe the traffic sign "Stop. Give way." and thereby endanger other road users?

options.text: An order to attend an advanced seminar for new drivers
Entry into the Central Register of Road Traffic Offenders
An order to resit a theoretical driving licence test

correct_answers.text: An order to attend an advanced seminar for new drivers
Entry into the Central Register of Road Traffic Offenders

comment: Failure to observe the traffic sign "Stop. Grant right of way" is a serious violation, an A violation, which is recorded in the driving qualifying register. In the event of an A-violation or two minor violations (B-violations) within the probationary period, you will have to attend a retraining seminar as a novice driver. You will not have to take an exam again.

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: What should be achieved by attending an advanced seminar during the probationary period?

options.text: A more considerate and risk-conscious attitude to driving on public roads
Improved risk awareness
Reducing the number of points in the Central Register of Road Traffic Offenders

correct_answers.text: A more considerate and risk-conscious attitude to driving on public roads

comment: At the retraining seminar you will learn how to analyze your daily driving behavior and raise your awareness of dangerous situations in the probationary period. Points cannot be deducted with the seminar. This can be done in the driving ability seminar.

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: Having committed several violations during the probationary period, the authorities have ordered a driver to attend an advanced seminar. The new driver fails to comply with the order. What may he now anticipate?

options.text: The withdrawal of the driving licence
A notice to pay a public fine
Additional points in the Central Register of Road Traffic Offenders

correct_answers.text: The withdrawal of the driving licence

comment: If the novice driver fails to attend the retraining seminar as required, he is threatened with the immediate loss of his driving license. An additional fine will not be imposed. Also, no points will be entered in the register of driver fitness.

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: What should a driving licence applicant anticipate if he is found driving without a licence?

options.text: The driving licence authority may withdraw the application inspection order
A test may be ordered to ascertain your aptitude for driving motor vehicles
No consequences, as long as you are registered with a driving school

correct_answers.text: The driving licence authority may withdraw the application inspection order
A test may be ordered to ascertain your aptitude for driving motor vehicles

comment: A person who wants to obtain a driving license not only has to bring along the necessary physical and mental requirements. In addition, he must not have repeatedly violated traffic regulations or penal laws. This would show that the applicant is not suitable for driving a motor vehicle. The same applies to driving without a license. Should a person, who wants to obtain a driving license, drive without one, the authorities might not allow you to attend the exam.

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: A learner driver has committed several violations during the probationary period. The authority has ordered that the driver attends a supplementary driving course. The learner driver fails to comply with this order. What can they expect to happen?

options.text: The withdrawal of their driving licence
An extension of the probationary period by another 3 years
An order to attend a driver fitness session

correct_answers.text: The withdrawal of their driving licence

comment: The probationary period for novice drivers is 2 years. During this time, very strict penalties from the catalogue of fines apply. If you commit an A offence or two B offences during the probationary period, you will be ordered to attend an advanced training seminar (ASF). If you do not comply with this official order, your driving licence will be revoked.

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: A driving licence applicant practices practical driving skills without a driving instructor on public roads. What should he expect if the police perform a check on him?

options.text: A criminal prosecution
A review of his fitness to drive a motor vehicle
No consequences provided he is accompanied in the vehicle by a holder of a driving licence

correct_answers.text: A review of his fitness to drive a motor vehicle

comment:
As a driving licence applicant, you are not allowed to drive on public roads without a instructor. Driving without a license is a criminal offence and can be punished with a fine or prison sentence.
The police can order a check of your ability to drive. As a driving license applicant, you run the risk of never receiving a driving license.

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: You are transporting commercial goods with a truck. What is the purpose of the 35-hour further training course, which you must attend within 5 years?

options.text: To increase awareness of health
To refresh my knowledge of the road haulage regulations
To acquire additional driving licence classes

correct_answers.text: To refresh my knowledge of the road haulage regulations

comment: When transporting commercial goods, the aim of the 35-hour training course is to increase health awareness and refresh knowledge of the regulations for freight transport.

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: Working as a professional driver requires you to complete a basic qualification and to regularly attend training programmes. Where will you find information concerning the validity period of your professional driver’s basic qualification?

options.text: On my driving licence
On the driver card
On the website of the Federal Motor Transport Authority

comment: You can find the information about the time limit on the back of your driving licence.

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: You are a commercial bus driver. What is the purpose of the 35-hour further training course, which you must attend within 5 years?

options.text: To increase awareness of health
To refresh my knowledge of the passenger transport regulations
To acquire additional driving licence classes

correct_answers.text: To refresh my knowledge of the passenger transport regulations

comment: If you are transporting people commercially by bus, within 35-hour training course you will learn how to increase health awareness and refresh your knowledge of the regulations for passenger transport. Participation is compulsory.

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: What can lead to a review of your fitness to be a bus driver?

options.text: - my physical capabilities
- my mental capacity
- the reliability of my employer

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: When can the authorities order a bus driver to undergo a fitness assessment?

options.text: If the driver has seriously violated road traffic regulations
If the driver has committed a serious road traffic offence
If there are indications that the bus driver has a high potential for aggression

correct_answers.text: If the driver has seriously violated road traffic regulations
If the driver has committed a serious road traffic offence
If there are indications that the bus driver has a high potential for aggression

question_text: After receiving your Class C driving licence for the first time, you want to transport goods commercially. How can you meet the requirements?

- a professional driver training programme

chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: After receiving your Class D driving licence for the first time, you want to transport passengers commercially. How can you meet the requirements?

options.text: - the accelerated initial qualification
- a professional driver training programme

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: To be employed as a professional driver, you will need an initial qualification as well as regular training. How are the relevant proofs documented?

options.text: On the driver qualification card
In the Federal Motor Vehicle and Transport Authority’s professional driver qualification register (KBA)
On the webpage of my driver licensing agency

correct_answers.text: In the Federal Motor Vehicle and Transport Authority’s professional driver qualification register (KBA)

comment: Professional drivers who work in the transport of goods or passengers on public roads require an initial qualification and then regular further training. The validity of these trainings are documented on the driver qualification certificate.

theme_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapter_name: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
question_text: What is documented on the driver qualification card?

options.text: - initial qualification
- training
- the issued driver’s licence

comment: Professional drivers who work in the transport of goods or passengers on public roads require an initial qualification and then regular further training. The validity of these trainings are documented on the driver qualification certificate.
